subject: Glidepath MAP: staffed canary windows, migration sprint, and training cadence
messages:
From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@luminexa.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: onboarding@luminexa.com
Date: 2026-06-05T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-signature MAP: next 90 days and training windows

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — excited to move into execution. Legal has countersigned and finance has the PO in flight; we expect final confirmation by next week. To help our internal stakeholders, can you send a focused MAP that calls out:

- recommended canary windows (2x options per week) for the first 4 weeks
- a lightweight migration sprint plan (data sync cutover, rollback criteria)
- an initial training schedule for engineering + ops (2 sessions + office hours)
- what success criteria and monitoring we should surface in the first 30 days

We have a constrained engineering calendar for June — ideally one canary window in the last week of June. Also please include any attachments we can circulate to the CTO and Head of Ops.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Price
Head of Platform Integrations, Luminexa Health
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@luminexa.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, onboarding@luminexa.com
Date: 2026-06-05T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-signature MAP: next 90 days and training windows

Samantha — thanks, congrats on the PO. Attached is a working Glidepath MAP (PDF) and a canary checklist (XLSX). High level summary below — I added concrete windows given your June constraints.

Plan highlights (short):
- Week 0 (pre-cutover): split smoke tests & config validation; data sync verification job runs nightly for 3 days
- Week 1-4 (canary phase): 3 incremental canary waves — low traffic subset (5%), medium (25%), then broad (75%) with automated fallback rule at any regression
- Canary windows suggested: Tue 23:00-01:00 and Thu 02:00-04:00 PDT (two options each week) — you requested last-week-of-June slot, proposed Tue 2026-06-29 23:00-01:00 PDT as pilot
- Migration sprint: 72-hour planned cutover with an embedded 8-hour rollback decision point; full runbook in the attached checklist
- Training: two 60-minute onboarding sessions (engineering deep-dive, ops runbook + alerting) + weekly 1-hour office hours for first 6 weeks
- Success metrics: < 200ms  p50 inference latency for target routes, error rate <0.5% by day 7 of each canary, no data-exfil events, and confirmed KV cache hit-rate baseline (see MAP appendix)

Open asks from our side so we can finalize the MAP:
1) Confirm which of your two engineering owners will be on-call for the pilot window (name + mobile)
2) Which monitoring team will own the SLO dashboard? (Grafana / Datadog / Other)
3) Any hard blackout dates in July — helps sequencing the medium and broad waves

I’ll loop in Marissa to propose training slots; Ben will coordinate the runbook validation and smoke test owners.

Thanks — I attached the Glidepath_MAP_v1.2.pdf and the Canary_Window_Checklist.xlsx for circulation.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Samantha Price <samantha.price@luminexa.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, onboarding@luminexa.com
Date: 2026-06-06T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-signature MAP: next 90 days and training windows

Adding training details and concrete slots for sign-off.

Proposed training cadence:
- Session A (Engineering deep-dive): 2026-06-30 09:00-10:00 PDT — focus on runtime behavior, quantization impact, and canary rollback signals
- Session B (Ops + Runbook): 2026-07-01 14:00-15:00 PDT — alert runbook, SLO dashboards, and on-call escalation path
- Weekly office hours: Thursdays 16:00-17:00 PDT (first session 2026-07-08) for the first 6 weeks

Materials attached: Training_Roster_and_Slots.csv (please fill in attendee names and primary owner for each session). For the engineering deep-dive I recommend 2 grinders from your infra team (owner + backup) be present; they will be asked to validate a KV-cache replay test during canary wave 1.

Ben: can you run the smoke test plan and confirm the script names we should execute during the pre-cutover nights?

Samantha — if those slots look OK I’ll create calendar invites and a lightweight pre-read (10 min) that you can forward to CTO/legal.

—Marissa
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@luminexa.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, onboarding@luminexa.com
Date: 2026-06-07T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-signature MAP: next 90 days and training windows

Thanks — slots work for us, and I’ve asked our infra lead (Evan Li) and ops manager (Priya Shah) to be present for the sessions. We’ll populate the Training_Roster_and_Slots.csv by EOD Monday.

One quick note: our security team asked for evidence of rollout rollback times in the checklist. Could you add an explicit measured rollback SLA (target < 2 hours from decision to rollback complete) and a short note on how KV-cache warmup is handled post-rollback?

If you can add that to the MAP doc and resend, I’ll route to our CTO for final go/no-go.

Samantha
